# sophosfirewall_static_route (Data Source)

Looks up an existing static route by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_static_route" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the static route. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `administrative_distance` (Number) Administrative distance (1-255); lower values are preferred. Defaults to `1`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `destination` (String) Destination network in CIDR notation, e.g. `192.168.10.0/24`. Use a `/32` for a host route.
- `gateway` (String) Next-hop IPv4 address.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `interface` (String) Name of the outgoing interface, e.g. `Port1`, or `Blackhole` to drop matching traffic.
- `metric` (Number) Routing metric (0-255). Defaults to `0`.
